title: Beanconqueror Brew Caffeine Load Leaderboard
dataSources: Beanconqueror brews (`beanconqueror:brew`), Acaia brew sessions (`acaia:brew`), Decent Espresso shots (`decent:shot`), Brewfather coffee recipes (`brewfather:coffee`), and tea-timer sessions (`teatimer:session`).
app: Beanconqueror brews, Acaia scale sessions, Decent Espresso shot telemetry, Brewfather coffee recipes, and tea-timer app exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=beanconqueror:brew caffeine_mg=*
| stats sum(caffeine_mg) as total_value, avg(caffeine_mg) as avg_value by recipe_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks recipe name values by total and average caffeine load across Beanconqueror brew events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `caffeine_mg` values for each Beanconqueror brew event and review total and average caffeine load by recipe name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total caffeine load.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which recipe name shows the biggest caffeine load numbers in your Beanconqueror brew data.
